from Crypto.Cipher import AES
from Crypto.Util.Padding import pad, unpad
from typing import Union


def encrypt_api(plain_text: str) -> str:
    """Encrypt hex string using AES-CBC."""
    key = bytes([89, 103, 38, 116, 99, 37, 68, 69, 117, 104, 54, 37, 90, 99, 94, 56])
    iv = bytes([54, 111, 121, 90, 68, 114, 50, 50, 69, 51, 121, 99, 104, 106, 77, 37])
    cipher = AES.new(key, AES.MODE_CBC, iv)
    cipher_text = cipher.encrypt(pad(bytes.fromhex(plain_text), AES.block_size))
    return cipher_text.hex()


def decrypt_api(cipher_text: str) -> bytes:
    """Decrypt hex string using AES-CBC."""
    key = bytes([89, 103, 38, 116, 99, 37, 68, 69, 117, 104, 54, 37, 90, 99, 94, 56])
    iv = bytes([54, 111, 121, 90, 68, 114, 50, 50, 69, 51, 121, 99, 104, 106, 77, 37])
    cipher = AES.new(key, AES.MODE_CBC, iv)
    plain_text = unpad(cipher.decrypt(bytes.fromhex(cipher_text)), AES.block_size)
    return plain_text


def encrypt_aes(data: bytes) -> str:
    """Encrypt bytes using AES-CBC and return hex string."""
    key = b'Yg&tc%DEuh6%Zc^8'
    iv = b'6oyZDr22E3ychjM%'
    cipher = AES.new(key, AES.MODE_CBC, iv)
    padded = pad(data, AES.block_size)
    encrypted = cipher.encrypt(padded)
    return encrypted.hex()
